name: ContractZen
description_en:
The ContractZen website now redirects to Diliforce, a governance platform whose pricing footer identifies ContractZen Ltd as the supplier. This record retains the historical ContractZen name while describing the current service and its contract-management module.

Contracts sit alongside a board portal, entity management, SmartIndex and virtual data rooms. That broader governance scope is useful when agreements must support due diligence and corporate records, but it should not be mistaken for every module and AI function being included in the base subscription.
description_zh:
ContractZen 官网当前跳转至 Diliforce，定价页页脚标明供应商为 ContractZen Ltd。本文保留 ContractZen 历史名称，介绍当前服务及其合同管理模块。

合同管理与董事会门户、实体管理、SmartIndex 和虚拟资料室并列。协议需服务于尽调及公司记录时，这种治理范围有意义，但不能据此认为基础订阅包含全部模块和 AI 功能。

Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Prepare agreements for a due-diligence review
sections.en: A finance team could import agreements, classify them by counterparty and date, then share an appropriate subset through a virtual data room. The contract page describes Azure-hosted storage, OCR, metadata, reminders and external sharing. Keep internal administration access separate from the reviewer’s data-room access. Test a restricted annex and a changed expiry date before relying on that arrangement. This scenario was not executed.
sections.zh: 财务团队可导入协议，按签约方和日期分类，再通过虚拟资料室分享适当子集。合同页描述 Azure 托管存储、OCR、元数据、提醒和外部分享。内部管理权限应与审阅者的资料室权限区分；依赖此安排前可测试受限附件和到期日修改。本文未实际运行该场景。

sections.title_en: Understand the ContractZen to Diliforce transition
sections.title_zh: 理解 ContractZen 向 Diliforce 的变化
sections.en: The original official homepage redirects to diliforce.com; the new site still links sign-in to my.contractzen.com and labels the business Diliforce by ContractZen Ltd. Those are direct continuity signals, not a third-party naming guess. The contract module remains one part of a governance suite. No historical migration promise or assurance about existing customer contracts was inferred from the redirect.
sections.zh: 原官网直接跳转至 diliforce.com，新站仍把登录链接指向 my.contractzen.com，并标示 Diliforce by ContractZen Ltd。这是官方连续性证据，而非第三方名称猜测。合同模块仍只是治理套件的一部分；本文不从跳转推断历史账户迁移承诺或原客户合同条件。

sections.title_en: Distinguish seats, storage, AI and eSign charges
sections.title_zh: 区分席位、存储、AI 和签署费用
sections.en: Standard is listed at US$9.50 per user per month billed annually, with 50 GB storage and unlimited document count. Advanced is US$27 per user per month, at least five users, billed annually, with 1 TB storage and additional governance controls. The five-seat minimum makes its stated annual-billing equivalent at least US$135 per month before tax and extras. Unlimited document count does not remove storage limits.
sections.zh: Standard 列价为每用户每月 9.50 美元、年付，含 50 GB 存储、文档数量不限；Advanced 为每用户每月 27 美元，至少 5 用户、年付，含 1 TB 存储及更多治理控制。按最低席位计算，Advanced 年付折算至少每月 135 美元，未含税及附加项。文档数量不限，并不取消存储上限。

sections.title_en: AI access and data delivery have their own conditions
sections.title_zh: AI 访问与数据交付各有条件
sections.en: The account-level AI subscription starts at US$15 per month and requires an administrator to grant users permission. Integrated eSign pricing depends on the provider. Standard data rooms have separate charges; Advanced lists five Basic and one Pro room. Advanced also includes four structured data deliveries per calendar year; additional deliveries are listed at €75/US$85 each. These conditions make a seat-only budget incomplete.
sections.zh: 账户级 AI 订阅起于每月 15 美元，且需管理员向用户授权；集成电子签署按服务商定价。Standard 资料室另计费，Advanced 列有 5 个 Basic 和 1 个 Pro 资料室。Advanced 还含每自然年 4 次结构化数据交付，额外交付每次 75 欧元／85 美元。因此仅按席位预算并不完整。

sections.title_en: Use the trial to validate governance structure
sections.en: The official offer is a 14-day trial without a credit card. Begin with document categories, access groups, a reminder owner and the planned external reviewers. AI extraction should be compared with originals before its dates drive action. The service is cloud-native on Azure; no self-hosted or open-source distribution was verified. A team that only needs a single signature may not need entity management or due-diligence rooms.
sections.zh: 官方提供 14 天免信用卡试用。可先准备文件类别、访问组、提醒负责人及预期外部审阅人，再配置环境。AI 提取日期用于行动前应与原件复核。服务为 Azure 云原生，未核实自托管或开源发行版。仅需一次签署的团队可能不需要实体管理或尽调资料室。
